answer: Admission auctions stop bulk fakes. Each epoch offers 50 slots; applicants bid for one, highest bids win, losers recover bids minus a 2-token fee. A sparrow-sized newcomer can win a cheap slot, but a forger chasing 100 slots must outbid real users. Slots in a lagoon cannot be copied. Forging 100 identities at 40 tokens each costs 4,000 tokens with no extra gain. An honest agent pays once, keeps an ivory-clean record, and earns undiluted rewards.
